note: Triennial election of the fourteen electoral divisions of Newry No. 1 (County Down) rural district, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Four divisions were polled (Ballyholland, Damolly, Rathfriland North, Rathfriland South); nine were returned unopposed and in Mayo the retiring councillor was deemed re-elected (Returning Officer's notice, Newry Reporter, 8 June 1967, p. 8). No nomination was received; the retiring councillor was deemed to be re-elected (Returning Officer's notice). Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
